Hope

John Langhorne (1735–1779)

S
UN
 of the Soul! whose cheerful ray
Darts o’er this gloom of life a smile;
Sweet Hope, yet further gild my way,
Yet light my weary steps awhile,
Till thy fair lamp dissolve in endless day.
